# What it is
Provides a struct to store arbitrarily typed data with a given amount of entries.

# Usage
Construct a new parameters by inheriting from one of the base parameter structs
```cpp
struct PARAMETER_NAME : public descriptors::FIELD_BASE<1> { };
```
The names of parameters should be typed in SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE.
Afterwards these are combined into a set of parameters called [parametersD](03_parametersD.qmd), which is then responsible for setting, getting and updating the values.

OpenLB defines a base set of parameters in [parameters.h](https://gitlab.com/openlb/release/-/blob/3dedbdd2c4d5e911eda3784643dd419b211951d0/src/case/parameters.h) that are commonly used in setups. These can be used in any simulation case without defining them.

## The base parameter structs
OpenLB supplies a list of base parameter structs, that fullfill different task

| Base Type              | Template Arguments                                    | What it stores                                                                              |
| ---------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| FIELD_BASE\<T>         | T: number of entries                                  | Stores a vector with given size, with a  default type of float or double as defined in case |
| TYPED_FIELD_BASE\<T,S> | T: data type of the parameter<br>S: number of entries | Stores a vector with given size and given data type                                         |
| ...                    |                                                       |                                                                                             |
